opening.argument: The offer pairs paid mining pools with a recruitment structure that pays sponsors when recruits make purchases. The pools are presented at $500, $1,000, and $2,000, while the speaker explains that the first two sponsored people generate a 5% commission on their purchases. Participants are also told to place recruits on a left and right team, and downline income is described as recurring: “paid over and over and over and over and over again on every single person in your downline.” The speaker further claims passive residual income if a participant builds a downline. Together, these claims show that earning is tied not only to Bitcoin mining, but to sponsoring purchasers and building a recruitment network. The video also promotes joining to earn Bitcoin.

citations.quote: the first two people that you sponsor, you're going to make 5% of whatever they purchase
as you're bringing people in, you have to put one person on your left, one person on your right
This is where you're going to get paid over and over and over and over and over again on every single person in your downline
we have true passive income and true passive residual income if you build a downline.
